inputs.style:
British Heavy Metal, epic and aggressive, driven by galloping double-bass drums, palm-muted 8-string guitar riffs, and a soaring, powerful vocal performance with deep baritone lows and high tenor screams. The mood is mystical and ominous, building to a triumphant, chaotic climax.
Choose the complete song's natural length and structure yourself. There is no required target duration. The safety ceiling is 900 seconds, not a goal to fill. Compose a coherent intro, verses, chorus and resolved final outro with final chord decay and silence. Finish all sung words and then end the song naturally. No endless loop or unfinished solo. Write explicit measures, no repeat signs.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Beneath the ancient stars,
Where the shadows dance and tear.
A symbol carved in stone,
Upon the mountain's throne.

The winds begin to howl,
They make the very walls recoil.
We walk the path of fire,
To see if we can endure the ire.

[Pre-Chorus]
Can you hear the drums begin?
Can you feel the pulse within?
A rhythm that shakes the ground,
Before the final sound.

[Chorus]
The Cipher of the Sun,
Burning bright, never done.
Six, nine, three, in the air,
The beast is waiting there.

The Cipher of the Sun,
Our journey has just begun.
With the power of the blade,
We will not be afraid.

[Verse]
Through the valley of the kings,
Where the silence starts to sting.
A mask of gold and rust,
A moment of absolute trust.

The lightning strikes the gate,
It seals our destiny's fate.
With a roar that splits the sky,
We look the demon in the eye.

[Pre-Chorus]
Can you hear the drums begin?
Can you feel the pulse within?
A rhythm that shakes the ground,
Before the final sound.

[Chorus]
The Cipher of the Sun,
Burning bright, never done.
Six, nine, three, in the air,
The beast is waiting there.

The Cipher of the Sun,
Our journey has just begun.
With the power of the blade,
We will not be afraid.

[Bridge]
(Heavy instrumental break)

[Verse]
Now the circle is complete,
We stand upon the street.
The number is revealed,
The secret finally healed.

No more fear, no more pain,
The beast breaks out again.
With the fire in our veins,
We conquer all our pains.

[Chorus]
The Cipher of the Sun,
Burning bright, never done.
Six, nine, three, in the air,
The beast is waiting there.

The Cipher of the Sun,
Our journey has just begun.
With the power of the blade,
We will not be afraid.

[Outro]
The Cipher of the Sun.
Burning bright.
Never done.
Six, nine, three.
In the air.
The beast is there.
[Final Chord]
